bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || { echo STK03_USERBOT_SERVICE_NOT_ACTIVE; exit 61; }
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || { echo STK03_USERBOT_SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED; exit 62; }
test "$(loginctl show-user "$USER" -p Linger --value)" = yes || { echo STK03_USERBOT_LINGER_NOT_ENABLED; exit 63; }
count="$(find . -maxdepth 7 -type f \( -name '*userbot*client*.py' -o -name '*userbot*ipc*.py' -o -name 'userbot_keepalive.py' \) ! -name '*.session*' | wc -l)"
if test "$count" -eq 0;then
 echo STK03_USERBOT_RESIDENT_IPC_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND
 exit 80
fi
if grep -RFl --include='*userbot*.py' 'room_public_readback' scripts artifacts deploy 2>/dev/null | grep -q .;then
 echo STK03_USERBOT_RESIDENT_HANDLER_CANDIDATE_PRESENT=PASS
else
 echo STK03_USERBOT_ALLOWLIST_NOT_CONFIRMED
 exit 81
fi
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 64
echo STK03_USERBOT_SERVICE_PRESERVED=PASS
